asr_text: Your agent passed the test once. Is it actually reliable? Agent outputs very between runs. One pass shows it can succeed. Set repeat count from 2 to 20 to run each test again. You get a pass rate green all past, amber at least 80%. Red means below 80%, something is broken. And failed runs are grouped by reason, so you see how it fails.
